reason: The plugin’s user-facing goal is a GitHub-backed Skill Market inside DSH settings: users can search for skill repositories, inspect them, and install or uninstall selected skills. Evidence shows it provides a dedicated settings UI plus local HTTP API routes and filesystem writes to the skill directory, making it an external-service integration utility rather than a coding, test, or analysis tool.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页中提供“技能市场”入口，可搜索 GitHub 技能仓库，并通过界面一键将技能安装到 ~/.dsh/skills 或从列表中卸载。
summaries.en: Adds a Skill Market entry in DSH settings to search GitHub for skills and install or uninstall them in ~/.dsh/skills from the web UI.

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a Skill Market section in DSH settings to search GitHub for skills and install/uninstall them in ~/.dsh/skills.
README documents same-origin JSON endpoints under /skill-market/api including search, repo inspection, install, installed listing, and uninstall.
package.json declares the plugin as a DSH web client entry with bundle patch integration, indicating UI injection into the settings page and host-side runtime behavior.
Repository tree includes host/index and browser/client components for separate server-side API logic and client-side interface, matching the described workflow.
